paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption: The character distribution in RoleplayPref consists of 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram presents a radial treemap illustrating the hierarchical distribution of character categories within RoleplayPref, showing three primary categories and thirteen subcategories. The central, largest circular segment is labeled "Virtual Characters" and is colored light blue, representing the most significant portion of the distribution. Surrounding this central segment are two concentric rings: the inner ring contains the "Real Characters" segment, colored green, and the outer ring contains the "Custom Characters" segment, colored pink. The outer ring also includes twelve subcategories arranged radially around it, labeled "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," "Game Characters," "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers," each with a distinct color ranging from light green to pale blue and pink, and visually occupying smaller proportional areas than the central "Virtual Characters" segment. The diagram does not include a legend or percentage labels within the segments, and all segments are presented without visual emphasis such as expansion or bolding. The segments are arranged radially around the central "Virtual Characters" segment, with the outer ring subcategories appearing to be ordered by size in descending order from left to right.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart visually represents the character distribution within RoleplayPref, which the paper states comprises three primary categories and thirteen subcategories. The chart is structured with a central ring divided into two main sections: a large light blue segment labeled “Virtual Characters” and a smaller green segment labeled “Real Characters.” The “Virtual Characters” category is further subdivided into six distinct slices—“Comic Characters,” “Movie Characters,” “Teleplay Characters,” “Novel Characters,” “Game Characters,” and “Custom Characters”—each rendered in a light blue hue and arranged around the central ring. The “Real Characters” category is subdivided into seven smaller slices—“Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers”—each in a light green hue, also arranged around the central ring. The chart includes a legend-like labeling system with text labels positioned directly on or near the corresponding slices, and there are no percentage values or numerical labels shown within the slices. The “Custom Characters” slice is visually distinguished by being slightly offset or exploded from the rest of the “Virtual Characters” ring, while all other slices appear to be standard-sized segments. The overall layout suggests a descending order of size for the subcategories within each primary category, with “Virtual Characters” occupying the largest portion of the chart.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Charakteren in RoleplayPref und gliedert sie in drei Hauptkategorien und 13 Unterkategorien, wobei der äußere Ring die Unterkategorien und der innere Ring die Hauptkategorien darstellt; der äußere Ring ist in sieben Segmente unterteilt, die als „Comic Characters“, „Movie Characters“, „Teleplay Characters“, „Novel Characters“, „Game Characters“ und zwei weitere, nicht vollständig lesbare Segmente, dargestellt sind, alle in einem hellblauen Farbton und jeweils mit einer ungefähr gleich großen Fläche, was auf eine ähnliche Größe oder Gewichtung hindeutet; der innere Ring ist in zwei Hauptsegmente unterteilt, „Virtual Characters“ in einem hellblauen Farbton und „Real Characters“ in einem grünen Farbton, wobei „Virtual Characters“ ein größeres Segment einnimmt und „Real Characters“ ein kleineres Segment darstellt, das weiter in drei Unterkategorien unterteilt ist: „Custom Characters“ in einem rosa Farbton, „Scientists“ in einem hellgrünen Farbton, „Artists“ in einem hellgrünen Farbton, „Athletes“ in einem hellgrünen Farbton, „Writers“ in einem hellgrünen Farbton, „Musicians“ in einem hellgrünen Farbton, „Actors“ in einem hellgrünen Farbton und „Influencers“ in einem hellgrünen Farbton, wobei „Custom Characters“ ein deutlich größeres Segment als die anderen Unterkategorien darstellt und die anderen Unterkategorien in etwa gleich großen Segmenten dargestellt sind, wobei keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente oder eine Legende angezeigt werden.
